Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: native-detail opaque painted game background source panel, Sundrop Village to Crossroads connector.
Input images: Image 1 is the single authoritative exact-coordinate control crop for the connector and its live handoff pads. Image 2 is only secondary color/composition guidance from the approved concept.
Primary request: paint a crisp hand-painted 2D JRPG top-down ground-only connector panel for fixed Meadow master-coordinate bounds x=2592..3392, y=4480..4896, exact output aspect 800x416. Preserve the control geometry and both neighbor handoffs exactly. Depict a scenic narrowing from warm cultivated village ground into neutral Crossroads packed earth: thinning cultivated grass, a gently worn packed-earth path aligned to the village-to-crossroads route, subtle ground flowers and leaf litter at edges, and very low lantern-footing contact shadows only as flat ground stains with no lanterns or posts.
Composition/framing: orthographic top-down ground plane only; the route is the hero. Keep the route mouth continuous and unobstructed through the full panel, preserve the 128px overlap context with Sundrop, and preserve the connector/Crossroads shared handoff at the east edge. Match the concept's warm late-morning palette but render crisp native-detail, not blur.
Constraints: opaque sRGB/RGBA raster; exact fixed framing; no buildings, roofs, doors, walls, fences, actors, NPCs, enemies, pickups, labels, text, UI, icons, lanterns, posts, bridges, props, rocks that read as blockers, or any tall object. All actual interaction/transition/anchor/encounter/spawn pads and collision clearances are quiet, low, flat ground; broad corridor masks retain natural terrain with no duplicate baked visual or false blocker. No false walls, no blocked route, no tile seams, no repeated grid, no watermark.
Avoid: perspective/isometric camera, hard rectangular biome bands, visual seam at either handoff, generator blur, repeated motifs, or object silhouettes.
